consumer.purpose: Optional read-only reconstruction of governed evidence for Creative Test Agent operations.

dependencies.provider_responsibility: Resolve a read-only reconstruction only from governed evidence while preserving provenance, Organization scope, redaction and incompleteness semantics.
dependencies.consumer_responsibility: Supply exact governed references and current access context; treat the reconstruction as derived evidence view rather than new canonical authority.
dependencies.failure_behavior: Fail closed when exact dependency/version/operation compatibility or governed evidence is unavailable.

lifecycle.onboard: Resolve the exact Provisional Product Contract and exact governed CAP-004 provider evidence before any reliance.
lifecycle.disable: Stop extension reliance without changing Creative Test Agent product state or Arvectum OS canonical state.
lifecycle.remove: Remove the declaration/adapter reliance after disable; retain only governance/audit evidence required by applicable policy.
lifecycle.upgrade: Create a new immutable declaration version and Product Contract version, then re-run exact governed dependency resolution; never infer compatibility or auto-fallback.
